envelope.reason: operator: the oracle's most useful time has passed; constrain it to core dimension names and values and never restrict consumers

payload.title: cold-decode oracle scope
payload.body: Operator ruling, rectified and adopted: the cold-decode oracle served the phase when cratylus was discovering its own terminology, and that phase is done; its constraints have since leaked past their purpose and fight industry-standard terms, which models already decode precisely without the overhead. Its scope becomes the corpus's core agent dimension names and values only. Everywhere else, including every surface a consumer of projected cratylus assets authors, the industry's own term is used as the industry understands it, and nothing cratylus ships holds a consumer to the oracle. Enters the design at the next plan's cut, as an amendment of prime principle (which names cold decode among the laws it is carried by).
